classes.title: Progressive Ballet Technique
classes.location: Wings Studio, 1649 SE Port St. Lucie Blvd., Port St. Lucie FL 34952
classes.participantNotes: Progressing Ballet Technique (PBT) is an innovative body-conditioning and strengthening program that has been designed to enhance students’ technique by focusing on training the muscle memory required in each exercise in all forms of dance. The program helps with injury prevention and rehabilitation and enhances the ability of athletes to perform at their best. With the use of an exercise ball, the students gain a great sense of posture and weight-placement whilst feeling each correct muscle group working throughout each exercise, which then stays with them when whilst performing in dance or their chosen field of sport. PBT focuses on core strength, weight placement and alignment of the body with a gradual approach of carefully designed exercises and repetitions of these exercises that trigger their muscle memory. ﻿ PBT is not only a program to improve technique in ballet dancers, but also now being appreciated and incorporated in training by all forms of dancers, athletes, physiotherapists and even footballers! Great class for horseback riders to strengthen core.

classes.location: Wings Studio, 1649 SE Port St. Lucie Blvd., Port St. Lucie FL 34952
classes.participantNotes: This is more than a class; it’s an immersive workshop experience designed for deeper understanding and real integration into daily life. Tasha Shirley—a seasoned Yoga Therapist, Qi Gong practitioner, meditation guide, and sound healing facilitator with Tibetan singing bowls—brings decades of experience and a heartfelt passion for helping others cultivate lasting peace. By the end of the workshop, you’ll walk away with personalized tools—breath practices, movements, meditations, and sound rituals—that empower you to maintain mindfulness, resilience, and wellbeing long after the session ends. This adaptive, compassionate approach makes the workshop welcoming and life-changing for everyone, whether you’re new to these practices or seeking fresh inspiration.

classes.title: Edgeworks Movement Lab with Crystal
classes.location: Wings Studio, 1649 SE Port St. Lucie Blvd., Port St. Lucie FL 34952
classes.participantNotes: EdgeWorks Movement is a guided improvisational practice for dancers and curious humans who want to move beyond the surface. Through structured exploration, creative prompts, spatial awareness, and optional partnering, participants build strength, mobility, coordination, and expressive range - all within a clear framework so no one feels lost. This class invites a childlike curiosity back into the body. It's a space to experiment, emote, take risks, and discover new movement pathways in a safe and supportive environment. Expect to leave feeling invigorated, open, and more connected - to your body, your creativity, and the people moving beside you. No performance pressure. No expectations. Just the freedom to explore your edge. EdgeWorks becomes: A home for: The dancer seeking more depth in their artistry The former dancer who misses artistry The mom who wants to feel alive again The adult who always wanted to dance The mover who doesn't want recital culture The human craving depth without heaviness

classes.title: Mindful Daily Movement with Sound Therapy
classes.location: Wings Studio, 1649 SE Port St. Lucie Blvd., Port St. Lucie FL 34952
classes.participantNotes: This is more than a class; it’s an immersive workshop experience designed for deeper understanding and real integration into daily life. Through gentle, restorative sessions rooted in yoga, Qi Gong, conscious breathing, sound and vibration therapy with Tibetan singing bowls, and diverse meditation techniques, Tasha guides participants to explore breath awareness, mindful movement, energy flow, and inner calm—nurturing balance across body, emotions, and spirit. Tasha Shirley—a seasoned Yoga Therapist, Qi Gong practitioner, meditation guide, and sound healing facilitator with Tibetan singing bowls—brings decades of experience and a heartfelt passion for helping others cultivate lasting peace. What makes this workshop truly special is Tasha’s intuitive, participant-centered teaching. She reads the room and each person’s energy, needs, abilities, and comfort level on the day, then customizes the practices accordingly - offering softer, accessible sequences for beginners, deeper relaxation for stress relief seekers, or gentle modifications to meet everyone exactly where they are. The intention is clear: to provide a supportive, transformative space where you not only experience profound presence and peace in the moment but also gain a versatile toolkit of ancient and practical techniques you can confidently pull from at home. By the end of the workshop, you’ll walk away with personalized tools—breath practices, movements, meditations, and sound rituals—that empower you to maintain mindfulness, resilience, and wellbeing long after the session ends. This adaptive, compassionate approach makes the workshop welcoming and life-changing for everyone, whether you’re new to these practices or seeking fresh inspiration.

sessions.title: Progressive Ballet Technique
sessions.description: Progressing Ballet Technique (PBT) is an innovative body-conditioning and strengthening program that has been designed to enhance students’ technique by focusing on training the muscle memory required in each exercise in all forms of dance. The program helps with injury prevention and rehabilitation and enhances the ability of athletes to perform at their best. With the use of an exercise ball, the students gain a great sense of posture and weight-placement whilst feeling each correct muscle group working throughout each exercise, which then stays with them when whilst performing in dance or their chosen field of sport. PBT focuses on core strength, weight placement and alignment of the body with a gradual approach of carefully designed exercises and repetitions of these exercises that trigger their muscle memory. ﻿ PBT is not only a program to improve technique in ballet dancers, but also now being appreciated and incorporated in training by all forms of dancers, athletes, physiotherapists and even footballers! Great class for horseback riders to strengthen core.

sessions.title: Mindful Daily Movement and Wellness
sessions.description: This is more than a class; it’s an immersive workshop experience designed for deeper understanding and real integration into daily life. Through gentle, restorative sessions rooted in yoga, Qi Gong, conscious breathing, sound and vibration therapy with Tibetan singing bowls, and diverse meditation techniques, Tasha guides participants to explore breath awareness, mindful movement, energy flow, and inner calm—nurturing balance across body, emotions, and spirit. Tasha Shirley—a seasoned Yoga Therapist, Qi Gong practitioner, meditation guide, and sound healing facilitator with Tibetan singing bowls—brings decades of experience and a heartfelt passion for helping others cultivate lasting peace. What makes this workshop truly special is Tasha’s intuitive, participant-centered teaching. She reads the room and each person’s energy, needs, abilities, and comfort level on the day, then customizes the practices accordingly - offering softer, accessible sequences for beginners, deeper relaxation for stress relief seekers, or gentle modifications to meet everyone exactly where they are. The intention is clear: to provide a supportive, transformative space where you not only experience profound presence and peace in the moment but also gain a versatile toolkit of ancient and practical techniques you can confidently pull from at home. By the end of the workshop, you’ll walk away with personalized tools—breath practices, movements, meditations, and sound rituals—that empower you to maintain mindfulness, resilience, and wellbeing long after the session ends. This adaptive, compassionate approach makes the workshop welcoming and life-changing for everyone, whether you’re new to these practices or seeking fresh inspiration.
